paras: Back to school at Sunset Court Sports! This week we have some great prices for basketball players. How much is a good pair of basketball shoes? Here, only sixty dollars.
T-shirts are cheap: twelve dollars each, or three for thirty. How many do you need? Take three and save six dollars.
Caps are twenty dollars. We have them in every color, but we don't have any small sizes this week. Sorry!
You can pay by card or in cash. And we always give you the right change. Any questions? Ask a person in a red T-shirt.
reading.source: Sale flyer -- Sunset Court Sports, Los Angeles

items: A good pair of basketball shoes is sixty dollars.
How much is a good pair of basketball shoes? Here, only sixty dollars.
Twelve dollars each, or three for thirty.
The store has small caps this week.
We don't have any small sizes this week.
You can pay by card or in cash.

listenings.text: Hi Bruno, it's Tyler. I'm at the mall and I need your help. They have some really cool basketball shoes here, but they are expensive: one hundred and twenty dollars. I don't have any cash, only my card, and my mom says the limit is one hundred. So, no shoes today. But the socks are cheap: five dollars for three pairs. How many pairs do you want? I can buy some for you. Oh, and they don't have any caps in your size. Call me back, OK?

Attention, shoppers. Today only, all T-shirts are ten dollars. How many can you take? Up to five per person. Shorts are twenty-five dollars, and caps are on sale for fifteen. We don't have any large sizes in the blue caps, sorry. Please pay at the front of the store. We take cash and cards, and we always give you a receipt. Thank you for shopping with us.

extra_audio.text: Bruno goes to a sports store on Saturday. He asks how much the T-shirts are. They are cheap, so he takes two. He pays in cash with a fifty-dollar bill. The cashier gives him his change and the receipt.
